items.desc: In Walyalup for her national Villain tour, Narrm’s Simona Castricum blends new wave, electro-punk, industrial, techno and house, spanning 70s radio, 80s music television and underground club culture. Her fifth album, the Balearic-rock Villain, is out through Trans-Brunswick Express. She’s remixed Courtney Barnett, opened for DJ Hell and worked with Aérea Negrot. From queer basements and fetish clubs to Golden Plains, Strawberry Fields and the airwaves of 3RRR and Skylab Radio, Castricum moves between underground and festival dancefloors.
items.title: Guest Mix w/ Simona Castricum
